area: Breakwater Sparrow AI (SparrowAIBoostPolicy_Breakwater, BreakwaterController nose row, Sparrow_Regatta)
summary: Sparrow run4, trained in the real game with time_ai_search.py, replaced run3's Breakwater drive and raised the Legendary nose from 7.9 to 13.9/s (lower difficulties keep #2109's rates; the lead stays 1.29). 2-14% faster on 32 fresh flights a side, most at Time 10. Regatta's Sparrow race line takes the same rate. promote_trained_drives.py --revert SparrowAIBoostPolicy_Breakwater puts run3 back.
